legend: There are n schoolchildren, boys and girls, lined up in the school canteen in front of the bun stall. The buns aren't ready yet and the line is undergoing some changes.

Each second all boys that stand right in front of girls, simultaneously swap places with the girls (so that the girls could go closer to the beginning of the line). In other words, if at some time the i-th position has a boy and the (i + 1)-th position has a girl, then in a second, the i-th position will have a girl and the (i + 1)-th one will have a boy.

Let's take an example of a line of four people: a boy, a boy, a girl, a girl (from the beginning to the end of the line). Next second the line will look like that: a boy, a girl, a boy, a girl. Next second it will be a girl, a boy, a girl, a boy. Next second it will be a girl, a girl, a boy, a boy. The line won't change any more.

Your task is: given the arrangement of the children in the line to determine the time needed to move all girls in front of boys (in the example above it takes 3 seconds). Baking buns takes a lot of time, so no one leaves the line until the line stops changing.
input: The first line contains a sequence of letters without spaces s1s2... sn (1 ≤ n ≤ 106), consisting of capital English letters M and F. If letter si equals M, that means that initially, the line had a boy on the i-th position. If letter si equals F, then initially the line had a girl on the i-th position.
output: Print a single integer — the number of seconds needed to move all the girls in the line in front of the boys. If the line has only boys or only girls, print 0.
note: In the first test case the sequence of changes looks as follows: MFM  →  FMM.
The second test sample corresponds to the sample from the statement. The sequence of changes is: MMFF  →  MFMF  →  FMFM  →  FFMM.

input.ai: 第一行包含一个不含空格的字母序列 s1s2... sn（1 ≤ n ≤ 106），由大写英文字母 M 和 F 组成。如果字母 si 等于 M，这表示最初队伍中第 i 个位置上是一个男孩。如果字母 si 等于 F，则表示最初队伍中第 i 个位置上是一个女孩。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，即将队伍中的所有女孩移动到男孩前面所需的秒数。如果队伍中只有男孩或只有女孩，则输出 0。

note.ai: 在第一个测试用例中，变化过程如下：MFM  →  FMM。
第二个样例对应题面中的样例。变化过程如下：MMFF  →  MFMF  →  FMFM  →  FFMM。

legend.ai: 有 n 名学生，包括男生和女生，正在学校食堂的包子摊前排队。包子还没有准备好，而队伍正在发生变化。
每秒钟，所有正好站在女生前面的男生会同时与女生交换位置（这样女生就能更靠近队伍的前端）。换句话说，如果某一时刻第 i 个位置是男生，而第 (i + 1) 个位置是女生，那么一秒后，第 i 个位置将变成女生，第 (i + 1) 个位置将变成男生。
举一个由四个人组成的队伍的例子：男生、男生、女生、女生（从队伍前端到末尾）。下一秒，队伍将变为：男生、女生、男生、女生。再下一秒将变为：女生、男生、女生、男生。再下一秒将变为：女生、女生、男生、男生。之后队伍将不再发生变化。
你的任务是：给定队伍中学生的排列，确定让所有女生都排在男生前面所需的时间（在上面的例子中需要 3 秒）。包子需要很长时间才能做好，因此在队伍停止变化之前，没有人会离开队伍。
